snippet.title: EPISODE 03 — THE FOUR VALVES OF THE HUMAN HEART 🫀
snippet.description:
🫀 The human heart contains four remarkable valves that control the direction of blood flow and help keep circulation moving properly.

This 3D anatomical visualization explores all four heart valves: the tricuspid valve, pulmonary valve, mitral valve, and aortic valve.

The tricuspid valve controls blood flow from the right atrium into the right ventricle, while the pulmonary valve allows blood to travel from the right ventricle toward the lungs.

On the left side, the mitral valve controls blood flow from the left atrium into the left ventricle. The aortic valve then allows oxygen-rich blood to leave the left ventricle and enter the aorta.

Through detailed anatomical views, discover the delicate valve leaflets, chordae tendineae, papillary muscles, and the amazing opening and closing movements that help prevent blood from flowing backward.

These four valves work together with extraordinary precision during every heartbeat. 🔬🩺

Explore the incredible anatomy of the human heart through realistic 3D medical visualization.

snippet.title: Trofi MotoGP Ini Menyimpan Nama Para Juara Dunia.
snippet.description:
Trofi juara dunia MotoGP ternyata bukan piala biasa! Tower of Champions menyimpan nama para juara dunia melalui plakat yang ditambahkan ke dalam menaranya.

Desain terbarunya diperkenalkan pada 2025, menggunakan plakat stainless steel yang terinspirasi dari sudut kemiringan pembalap saat menikung.

Marc Márquez ikut menorehkan sejarah dengan gelar kedelapan MotoGP dan gelar dunia kesepuluh sepanjang kariernya pada 2026. Perayaannya pun dibuat unik dengan simbol GOAT dan selebrasi SIUU ala Cristiano Ronaldo.

Sebuah trofi yang bukan hanya menjadi hadiah, tetapi juga menyimpan sejarah para legenda MotoGP.

Arriving in India for his first bilateral foreign visit, Balen Shah embraced PM Modi the moment he stepped out of his vehicle. He brought gifts for the Prime Minister, including a rudraksha bead and sandalwood from the Pashupatinath Temple. In return, PM Modi gifted him sacred water (Ganga jal) from the Triveni Sangam in Prayagraj. Throughout this interaction, PM Modi offered him high praise, during which Balen Shah appeared quite nervous, repeatedly touching his clothes.

snippet.title: Jamie Raskin EXPOSES the Real Math Behind "Nine Justices" on the House Floor
snippet.description:
On the House floor on September 2, 2026, Representative Jamie Raskin (D-MD) argued against House Joint Resolution 1, a proposed constitutional amendment sponsored by Representative Andy Biggs (R-AZ) that would permanently fix the U.S. Supreme Court at nine justices.

According to Raskin, Article III of the Constitution gives Congress the authority to set the size of the Court—a power Congress has exercised seven times in U.S. history, with the bench ranging from five to ten justices—and freezing the number at nine would lock in the current 6–3 conservative majority rather than reflect the nation's 13 federal judicial circuits. Conversely, Biggs and House Speaker Mike Johnson stated that permanently establishing nine seats prevents either political party from expanding the Court after future elections. The resolution ultimately failed to pass the House, receiving a 212–206 vote that fell short of the two-thirds supermajority required for constitutional amendments.

**Key Moments in This Video:**

* **0:00** – Overview of H.J. Res. 1 and the Supreme Court debate
* **0:50** – Rep. Jamie Raskin's House floor remarks on constitutional history and court size
* **11:29** – Final House vote breakdown and political context ahead of the 2026 midterms

snippet.title: Five Divers Swam Into This Cave. None of Them Came Back 🦈
snippet.description:
In May 2026, six Italians on a dive boat in the Maldives got ready to explore an underwater cave the locals call Shark Cave. Its mouth sits about 180 feet down, twice as deep as tourists are allowed to dive. At the last minute the sixth diver decided to stay on the boat. The other five each carried a single tank of ordinary air and no guideline. They planned to be back within an hour. Nobody came up. That evening, search divers found their guide Gianluca near the entrance, his tank empty. A military diver who went in to look again later died. Then three Finnish cave divers, the same team that once brought their friends out of a flooded cave in Norway, followed fin marks in the sand into a narrow opening beside the tunnel. All four were there, together. The Finnish team believes that on the way back, a cloud of stirred-up sand hid the real tunnel, and the dead-end opening beside it looked like the way out. Only Gianluca found his way back to the first room, and that's where his air ran out.
